name: Europe hybrid attacks
value: Freezer attacks in 11 EU states (2–3 Nov)
summary: Cyberattacks on supermarket freezers across 11 EU countries; Jersey drone closures
state: Cyberattacks on 2–3 Nov caused refrigeration failures in supermarkets in 11 EU countries, which the EU called a deliberate attempt to disrupt food supply; nobody has claimed them and Romania's cyber chief said they looked semi-amateurish (AFP via The Citizen). Drones closed Jersey airspace on 30–31 Oct. No attack has been attributed to a state.
for_you: Report suspicious drones to police; follow NCSC guidance on securing internet-connected equipment.
rubric_hit: Drone airport closure; unattributed sabotage = Watch

sources.title: The Citizen (AFP) — Italy holds security talks after European freezer cyberattacks
Dronewatch — RAF deploys counter-drone team to Jersey

why: Sabotage, arson and drone incursions over airports and bases are how state confrontation reaches daily life in the UK and Europe.
drivers: Russia–NATO tensions, drone and cyber capabilities, proxy recruitment, elections.

rubric.alert: Repeated airport or infrastructure shutdowns across several countries, or sabotage causing casualties or a major outage.
rubric.watch: Drone incursions close an airport or military base, or a sabotage incident is attributed to a state.
rubric.normal: No significant attributed sabotage or airspace incursions in Europe this week.
